summary: The article level of the outline list (the level the Arch Article style numbers with) loses its zero padding: 1.01 becomes 1.1, 2.03 becomes 2.3; the change is made in the list's definition, so every article follows. A file whose style is missing or not numbered is left as it is.
assumptions: the articles are numbered by the list level of the 'Arch Article' style (as the profiles show it)
only the zero padding changes (decimalZero becomes decimal); the PART number before the dot and the paragraph letters stay
every list that shares the definition follows (flagged); never tracked
